verdict.rationale: Bento's API/CLI clearly supports creating/updating tags on subscribers and filtering/reading back subscribers by tag or segment (bento-docs-8, bento-docs-14, bento-docs-45, bento-docs-49), and segments are documented as saved filters that auto-update membership (bento-docs-42). However, there's no explicit evidence of an API/CLI endpoint to programmatically create or update a segment definition itself (only to filter by existing ones), and 'lists' as a distinct object aren't clearly documented. Missing for 10: documented segment-creation/update endpoint, explicit 'list' object support, and a worked example reading back full membership.
